title: Beca Doctoral PUCP
institution: Pontificia Universidad Católica del Perú (PUCP), Escuela de Posgrado

compensation.value: S/ 4,000 monthly allowance for 12 months (renewable up to two times); academic and enrolment fees covered

about: PUCP's doctoral scholarship for the 2027-1 intake gives admitted PhD students a monthly allowance of S/ 4,000 for 12 months, renewable up to two times, with academic and enrolment fees covered. The call runs 10 August to 4 November 2026.
requirements: Master's degree and endorsement from a PUCP adviser linked to the doctoral programme
Peruvian or foreign nationals studying with exclusive dedication; admission to the doctoral programme required
PUCP full-time faculty and full-dedication staff excluded
Documents: personal essay, research project, CV, two recommendation letters, adviser commitment letter, ethics declaration, English certificate

upskill.name: AI for Research & Information Synthesis
why: "Documents: personal essay, research project, CV..." → "Use AI to explore, organize, and structure information collected from multiple documents or professional sources."
"research project" → "Transform complex information into research briefs, comparison matrices, executive summaries, and actionable recommendations."
